title: Official Rules — Leadville Race Series (safety, support, course integrity, timing, protests)
claims: Participants must provide a working emergency contact number that is not their own; international participants must provide a working WhatsApp or equivalent international number.
The use of IV fluids during the race is prohibited and results in immediate disqualification.
Support crews, friends and family are allowed only at official crewing locations; support offered outside official crew checkpoints results in disqualification.

The official course must be followed at all times; shortcuts or alternate routes are not permitted; athletes are responsible for safe navigation; courses are marked but GPS devices are recommended as backup; GPS files are available on each event page.

Athletes must pass over the timing mats at each official checkpoint; reaching a checkpoint after the cutoff means the time will not be scored and the athlete is no longer an official participant; DNFs must be reported to timing officials.

A government-issued photo ID is required at sign-in; packets are given to registered athletes only; participants under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian's consent, with the guardian present at check-in.

Participants needing medical assistance should seek help at the nearest aid station; in emergencies dial 911; in weather or other emergencies participants must follow instructions provided by race officials.
Protests must be submitted to the event director no later than 30 minutes before the awards ceremony; final decisions are made by the event director and officials panel.
No earbuds or over-the-ear headphones are allowed; bone-conduction headphones are allowed.

The Race Director and race officials have ultimate authority to change, void or amend rules in unforeseen or extenuating circumstances; disregard or violation by a participant, crew or spectator may result in disqualification at their discretion.
